title: ISTA Scientific Internships — Year-Round
summary: Host-arranged scientific internships in Austria in natural sciences, mathematics and computing.
eligibility: Current/completed bachelor’s or master’s students in eligible science and related disciplines.

prize.description: Minimum gross salary of €1,583 per month under an employment contract with ISTA.

notes: Rolling host-contact process; register formally at least two months before arrival.
support: Housing not free (campus flats can be rented, subject to availability) · no travel funding · visa documents provided for non-EU/EEA applicants · no application fee
